cases.name: Brenda M. Henderson
cases.about: Jamie Chancey, a close friend and university colleague, said Henderson “loved helping students” reach their goals. Chancey was one of three women from the university who attended Monday’s bail hearing. “She had a heart of gold,” Chancey said. “She was working on her second master’s (degree), but she always put everyone else first. She was well loved by hundreds of people at Bellevue (University).”

cases.name: Emily Price
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "She was a very bright child who loved learning and was excited for Kindergarten this fall. She was artistic, loved singing and dancing, and called herself a little princess. Emi also loved unicorns, chocolate and the movie Frozen."

Her mother Mary Nielsen said her children were bright and playful. “They were happy, sweet, loving,” she said. “My daughter was extremely smart, you wouldn’t know she just turned 5."
